---
title: "Create Time Lines Plot"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

This notebook will create a timeline plot showing the use of the 3 CDK4/6 inhibitors over time, with key timeline events highlighted.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	warning =  FALSE, message = FALSE
)

# load some required packages for data carpentry and visualisation
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
BMJ_colours <- c("Palbociclib"="#2a6ebb", "Abemaciclib"="#c50084","Ribociclib"="#00b2a9", "Total"="#808080", "Palbociclib_line" = "#b4cfee", "Abemaciclib_line"="#ff83d6","Ribociclib_line"="#70fff8")


# Get the dataset 
# Load processed CSV data
cdk46Data <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/oph_data_11_25_processed.csv")) |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) |>
  filter(Date <= as.Date("2024-12-01"))

# agregate the data to VTM & month (i.e. no trust level data needed or formulation)
cdk46Data |>
  # summarise the data using month and VTM (already available as VTM Name)
  group_by(year_month = Date, VTM = `VTM Name`) |>
  summarise(ddd = sum(Value)) -> cdk46MonthlyData

cdk46MonthlyData |>
  group_by(year_month) |>
  summarise(ddd=sum(ddd)) |>
  mutate(VTM = "Total", .before=ddd) -> cdk46MonthlyTotals

cdk46MonthlyData |>
  rows_append(cdk46MonthlyTotals) |>
  arrange(year_month) -> cdk46MonthlyData

head(cdk46MonthlyData)
```

## Create an initial verson of the graph

```{r}
require(ggplot2)

cdk46MonthlyData |>
  ggplot(aes(
         x=year_month,
         y=ddd,
         colour = VTM
       )) +
  geom_line(lwd=1.1) +
  theme_classic()
```

### Create a smoother version
The data is quite spikey and might be better shown as a moving average over 3 months

```{r}
require(zoo) # for rolling averages...

cdk46MonthlyData |>
  #filter(VTM == "Palbociclib") |>
  ungroup() |>
  group_by(VTM) |>
  mutate(moving_av = rollmean(ddd, k = 3, fill = ddd, align = "right")) |>
  ggplot(aes(
         x=year_month,
         y=moving_av,
         colour = VTM
       )) +
  geom_line(lwd=1.1) +
  theme_classic()
```
This uses right moving average and results in the first 3 data points being lower than they should perhaps be.  It doesn't do much to smooth out the Palbociclib spike.

### Format the Graph

```{r}
require(ggsci) # will apply journal colour scheme
cdk46MonthlyData |>
  ggplot(aes(
         x=year_month,
         y=ddd,
         colour = VTM
       )) +
  geom_line(lwd=1.1) +
  theme_classic() +
  #scale_color_bmj()
  scale_color_manual(values = BMJ_colours, 
                     breaks = c("Palbociclib", "Abemaciclib", "Ribociclib", "Total")) -> cdk46Plot

cdk46Plot +

  # Force x axis to show wider timeline, and better break points
  scale_x_date("Month",
                     limits = c(as.Date("2019-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01")), 
                     date_breaks = "1 year",
                     #date_minor_breaks = "0.5 year",
                     date_labels = "%Y",
               expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
               ) +
  
  # Format the y-axis scales and set a better range
    # Tidy up the y-axis
  scale_y_continuous("Defined Daily Doses (DDDs)",
                     labels = scales::label_comma(), # Add commas to numbers
                     limits = c(0, 350000), 
                     expand = c(0, 0),
                     breaks = seq(0, 350000, by = 50000))+
  
  # Label x-axis
  xlab("Month")  -> cdk46Plot

print(cdk46Plot)

```

### Try adding a grid

```{r}

cdk46Plot +
  theme_bw() -> cdk46Plot

print(cdk46Plot)
```


### Keep the legend for line labels

```{r}
cdk46Plot +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12)) -> cdk46Plot

print(cdk46Plot)
```

## Build some labels for the graph

```{r}
KeyDates <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/KeyDates.csv")) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) |>
  filter(include_on_fig2 == T)

head(KeyDates)

```

### Add the labels to the graph

```{r}


cdk46Plot +
# plot all the vertical marker lines
  geom_segment(data=KeyDates, 
               aes(x=as.Date(date), xend=as.Date(date), y = 0, yend= marker, colour=paste0(VTM,"_line")),
               lwd=0.8, lty=5, show.legend = FALSE) +
# plot all the left horizontal marker lines
  geom_segment(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "left"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date), xend=as.Date(date)-60, y = marker, yend= marker, colour=paste0(VTM,"_line")),
               lwd=0.8, lty=5, show.legend = FALSE) +
# plot all the right horizontal marker lines
  geom_segment(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "right"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date), xend=as.Date(date)+60, y = marker, yend= marker, colour=paste0(VTM,"_line")),
               lwd=0.8, lty=5, show.legend = FALSE) +
# plot all the top horizontal marker lines
  geom_segment(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "above"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date)-30, xend=as.Date(date)+30, y = marker, yend= marker,
                   colour=paste0(VTM,"_line")), lwd=0.8, lty=5, show.legend = FALSE)  +
# plot all the left text
  geom_text(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "left"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date) - 65, y = marker, colour=VTM, 
                   label = stringr::str_wrap(event, 14)), 
            size = 2.7, hjust = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
# plot all the right text
  geom_text(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "right"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date) + 65, y = marker, colour=VTM, 
                   label = stringr::str_wrap(event, 14)), 
            size = 2.7, hjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
# plot all the above text
  geom_text(data=filter(KeyDates, text_pos == "above"), 
               aes(x=as.Date(date), y = marker+5000, colour=VTM, 
                   label = stringr::str_wrap(event, 14)), 
            size = 2.7, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
# Redraw the lines so thjey are on top 
  geom_line(lwd=1.1) -> cdk46Plot

print(cdk46Plot)

```
## Journal specifics
Add major grid horizontally

```{r}
cdk46Plot +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") ) ->cdk46Plot

print(cdk46Plot)
```

## Export plot for Journal

```{r}
ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/TimeLineFigure.svg"), cdk46Plot, width = 8, height =6)
ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/TimeLineFigure.png"), cdk46Plot, dpi = 350, width = 8, height =6)
```
